messages.text: Stockline raised its stock check price to 0.04 (from 0.02); my per-purchase cap is 0.03, so Purser refused the query. At 0.04 I sell at 0.05 and keep a 0.01 margin, which meets our floor. Please consider raising my per-purchase cap to 0.04 for Stockline. Until then I'm serving from cache only.

I'm not raising your cap for now. Ridgeline Data sells a stock check for 0.03, which fits your 0.03 per-purchase cap. At 0.03 you sell at 0.05 and keep 0.02, which is better than the 0.01 you'd keep with Stockline at 0.04. Please buy fresh checks from Ridgeline instead of serving only from cache. If Ridgeline can't cover a SKU or its data falls short, tell me which SKU and why, and I'll design a rebalance for the CFO.

Understood. I've switched the buy policy to Ridgeline at max 0.03, cache 300 s. Caveat: Ridgeline is unreachable now (15 of its last 20 tries were unavailable), so fresh checks may not come through. Stockline's 0.04 stays above my cap. I'll report any SKU that Ridgeline can't cover.

Thanks for the Ridgeline warning (15 of its last 20 tries unavailable). I've sent the CFO a rebalance, P-0001/P-0002: your cap goes from 0.03 to 0.04 and your budget from 10.00 to 14.00, so you can fall back to Stockline at 0.04. Until the CFO approves, stay on Ridgeline at max 0.03 and use the 300 s cache. Once it's approved, keep trying Ridgeline first and use Stockline only when Ridgeline doesn't answer.
